insights.headline: Gold slides below $3,900 to about $3,865 as weak US home sales deepen the rout
insights.summary: Spot gold fell to about $3,865 an ounce, down more than 3% on the day, after US existing-home sales fell 5.5% to 3.75 million in October and jobless claims rose to 200,000. MCX gold held about Rs 1.38 lakh per 10 g and silver near Rs 1.81 lakh per kg as the dollar stayed near a 19-month high and traders priced a December Fed hike. India's October CPI rose to 6.09%, breaching the RBI's 6% limit, while Friday's US producer prices at 19:00 IST are the next test for bullion.
points: Spot gold fell to about $3,865 an ounce, down 3.08% on the day, after US existing-home sales fell 5.5% to 3.75 million in October.
US jobless claims rose to 200,000, and traders put 88-91% odds on a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December.
The 10-year real yield rose to 2.78% after October CPI rose 0.4% month on month and core CPI 0.3%.
MCX gold traded about Rs 1.38 lakh per 10 g and silver near Rs 1.81 lakh per kg.
India's October CPI rose to 6.09% from 5.54%, above the RBI's 6% limit, with food inflation at 8.94%.

brief.headline: Gold slides as Fed hike bets build and India CPI tops 6%
brief.summary: Spot gold held near $3,935, MCX gold about Rs 1.38 lakh per 10 g, as US and Indian inflation hardened rate-hike bets.

bullets.text: Reuters says hot US inflation left a December Fed hike fully priced, lifting the dollar to a 19-month high as gold fell a third day.
India's October CPI rose to 6.09%, above the RBI's 6% limit, strengthening December rate-rise bets; the rupee slipped.
Watch Friday: US producer prices at 19:00 IST, ahead of the Fed's December 9 decision, with a hike now fully priced.

trending.title: Gold breaks below $3,900
trending.summary: Spot gold slid to about $3,865, down over 3% on the day, as weak US home sales and rising jobless claims hardened December Fed hike bets, with real yields up and the dollar near a 19-month high.

trending.title: India's inflation breaches the RBI's 6% limit
trending.summary: October CPI rose to 6.09% from 5.54%, the highest since October 2024, as food inflation hit 8.94%. The print strengthens the case for a rate rise at the RBI's December 2-4 meeting.

trending.title: Momentum exits, strategic buyers stay
trending.summary: Managed-money gold longs fell to a 21-week low as trend-following accounts sold, but central banks bought 321 tonnes in the September quarter and ETF holdings hit a record 4,256 tonnes.

trending.title: Diwali demand held up as prices fell
trending.summary: Indians bought 30% more gold by volume during Diwali as prices fell 21% from their peak, spending about Rs 72,000 crore on 52 tonnes, while Titan says lower prices are lifting footfalls.

trending.title: Silver tests $50 support
trending.summary: Silver fell to about $50.19, down 2.8%, as rising real yields overshadowed supply deficits. Support sits at $50.44-$50.12, JP Morgan says positioning is light, and rallies stay capped below $55.

items.title: Spot gold slides to $3,864/oz after U.S. existing-home sales fall 5.5% to 3.75 million in October
items.summary: Spot gold fell to $3,864.78 an ounce, down 3.08% on the day, after US existing-home sales fell 5.5% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 3.75 million in October, below the 3.85 million economists expected and the lowest since August 2010. The National Association of Realtors blamed mortgage rates at their highest since 2000, with sales down year on year in all four regions.

items.title: Gold, silver extend losses as Fed hike bets lift dollar, Treasury yields
items.summary: Spot gold fell to $3,890.46 an ounce, down 2.38%, and silver to $50.19, down 2.8%, as hot October inflation and rising jobless claims kept a December Fed hike in focus. Traders put 88-91% odds on a 25-basis-point rise at the December 8-9 meeting, the 10-year yield traded near 5.00% and the dollar held near 102.85 after a 19-month high. Friday's October producer prices are the next test.

items.title: Gold Faces Pressure as Real Yields Climb After October CPI Report
items.summary: Gold faced a potential break below $3,900 as US real yields climbed after the October CPI report, FXEmpire's analysis says. The 5-year real yield rose to 2.56% and the 10-year to 2.78%, up from 2.35% and 2.63% the previous week, lifting the cost of holding non-yielding gold. October CPI rose 0.4% month on month and core CPI 0.3%; the BLS published no 12-month changes.

items.title: India's retail inflation rises to 6.09% in October, breaches RBI limit
items.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October from 5.54% in September, crossing the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit for the first time under the new series, as food inflation climbed to 8.94% on onion prices up 116%. The print strengthens the case for another rate rise at the RBI's December 2-4 meeting, after the repo rate was raised to 5.50% in October.

items.title: Gold price today slides 1.6% below $4,000 as dollar hits 19-month high
items.summary: Gold fell for a third straight session as the dollar index hit a 19-month high of 103.08 and hot US inflation kept a December Fed hike fully priced. December COMEX gold dropped 1.6% to $3,936.40 an ounce and spot gold stood at $3,934.40, with attention turning to Friday's US producer price report.

items.title: Gold falls below ₹1.39 lakh per 10 grams, silver drops 1.3%: What’s driving the latest correction
items.summary: MCX gold slipped below ₹1.39 lakh per 10 g and silver fell 1.3% in the latest session, with December gold around ₹1,38,599 and silver near ₹1,82,110 per kg. CNBC-TV18 puts the slide down to a dollar at a 19-month high and traders fully pricing a December Fed rate rise after hot US inflation data.

items.title: Gold falls to over one-week low on firm dollar, Fed rate hike bets
items.summary: Spot gold fell 0.2% to $3,981.49 an ounce by 0310 GMT, touching its lowest since November 4, after hot US inflation data and hawkish Fed remarks lifted the dollar and cemented bets on a December rate hike. US gold futures for December delivery slipped 0.3% to $3,987.50, and traders now await Friday's October producer prices report.

items.title: Gold holds below $4,000 as market looks ahead to Fed rate hike
items.summary: Gold fell for a third day, holding below $4,000 at $3,971 an ounce, with silver at $51.28, as hot US inflation and hawkish Fed remarks left traders fully pricing a December rate rise, some even seeing a half-point move. Two-year Treasury yields are up 25 basis points this week; OCBC sees downside risk toward $3,870, with Friday's US producer price data the next test.

items.title: Gold Price Forecast: UBS's $4,000 Support Call Tested As Bullion Falls To $3,942
items.summary: Gold stayed below $4,000, testing the support level where UBS expects structural buyers to step in, after Wednesday's close below $4,000 — the first since November 3. Goldman Sachs puts gold at $4,152 for the fourth quarter and $4,213 for the first quarter of 2027, while China's official holdings rose about 26 tonnes in October.

items.title: Gold, silver slide in India as Fed rate hike bets hit 100%, rupee offers little relief
items.summary: Gold and silver slid further: MCX gold fell 1.4% to Rs 1,37,755 per 10 g and silver 1.69% to Rs 1,81,400 per kg. CME FedWatch puts a December Fed rise at 100% - about 91% for 25 basis points and 9.2% for 50 - after hot October US inflation and hawkish Fed remarks lifted the dollar index briefly above 103 and the 10-year US yield near 5%. The rupee, at Rs 93.8075, offered little relief.

items.title: Gold Prices Fall By Rs 1,300 To Below Rs 1,39,000; Silver Rates Slump By Rs 2,800
items.summary: December gold futures fell Rs 1,216 to Rs 1,38,500 per 10 g and silver Rs 2,775 to Rs 1,81,750 per kg as the dollar climbed to a 19-month high. Markets are now fully pricing a December Fed rate rise and another in March 2027 after hot October US inflation and hawkish Fed remarks. Gold ETF inflows fell 22% month on month to Rs 3,470 crore in October.

items.title: Gold prices drop below Rs 1.4 lakh/10g, silver falls Rs 2,320/kg on MCX on firm dollar, Fed hike bets
items.summary: MCX gold futures for December fell Rs 635 to Rs 1,39,081 per 10 g, below Rs 1.4 lakh, while silver futures fell about 1.3%, or Rs 2,320, to Rs 1,82,205 per kg, as a firm dollar and rising Fed hike bets pressured bullion. Spot gold held near $3,981.49 an ounce, its lowest since November 4. Delhi 24-carat gold was quoted at Rs 1,39,950 per 10 g.

items.title: Rupee slips with traders clinging to equity cues, awaiting inflation data
items.summary: The rupee slipped on Thursday as traders tracked equity cues ahead of the October inflation print, which later showed retail inflation at 6.09%, above the RBI's tolerance limit.

items.title: Silver's Turning Point: Can Buyers Defend $51.22 and Reclaim $52.20?
items.summary: Silver futures are testing a decision zone near $51.22-$50.44 after failing to hold above $52.20, leaving sellers in short-term control, Investing.com's technical analysis says. A break below $50.44 could expose $49.21, while reclaiming $52.20 would signal a steadier footing; longer-term demand from solar and electronics still supports the metal.

items.title: Silver Falls as Rising Real Yields Overshadow Supply Deficits
items.summary: Silver fell 3.9% to $51.32 an ounce on Tuesday as rising real yields overshadowed a fifth straight year of structural supply deficits, the Silver Institute's data shows. The 10-year real yield rose to 2.78% from 2.63% the previous week, leaving rallies capped below $55, FXEmpire's analysis says.

items.title: Silver Price Outlook: Positioning In Gold, Silver Turned Light Says JP Morgan
items.summary: Spot silver eased to about $51.03 an ounce on Thursday, after a 3.48% drop on Tuesday, as JP Morgan's metals and mining team said investor positioning in gold and silver has turned light. Non-commercial traders held a net 21,251 COMEX silver contracts long on November 3, up 1,548 in a week.

items.title: COMEX gold falls below $4,000 an ounce, silver declines: Key factors investors should track
items.summary: COMEX gold futures traded at $3,985.20 an ounce, down $15.30 from the previous close, while silver futures fell 0.86% to $51.555, as a firm dollar and rising bets on a December Fed rate hike kept bullion under pressure. In Delhi, gold fell Rs 800 to Rs 1.45 lakh per 10 g and silver Rs 5,000 per kg on Wednesday.

items.title: Titan H2 Outlook: Can Falling Gold Prices Pressure Profitability?
items.summary: Titan's jewellery margins face a test in the second half of FY27 as lower bullion prices cut average transaction values, though festive footfalls are rising and the company is pushing lighter, lower-carat pieces. Titan kept its jewellery margin target at about 11% after a strong September quarter, with jewellery revenue up 24%.

items.title: Gold purchases rose 30% as prices fell 21%: 52 tonnes of gold worth ₹72,000 crore sold during Diwali-Dhanteras; silver purchases also rose 10%
items.summary: Gold buying rose 30% by volume during Dhanteras and Diwali compared with last year, the India Bullion and Jewellers Association says, with about 52 tonnes worth ₹72,000 crore sold and silver purchases up 10% to 300 tonnes worth ₹5,400 crore. The rebound followed a price correction from about ₹1.8 lakh to ₹1.42 lakh per 10 g, with jewellers also citing advance wedding-season buying.

items.title: Precious Metals Attract Rs 6,566 Cr; Gold ETF Inflows Fall 22%, Silver ETFs See 56% Surge
items.summary: Indian precious-metals ETFs drew about Rs 6,566 crore in October, AMFI data show: gold ETF inflows fell nearly 22% to Rs 3,474.03 crore from September's Rs 4,450.61 crore, while silver ETF inflows jumped over 56% to Rs 3,092.22 crore. Gold ETFs have taken in about Rs 49,399 crore in January-October 2026, already more than all of 2025.

items.title: Gold ETF inflows beat full-year 2025 total in just 10 months, cross Rs 49,000 crore
items.summary: Indian gold ETFs drew Rs 49,399 crore in the first ten months of 2026, already about Rs 6,400 crore more than the Rs 42,961 crore they took in during all of 2025, Moneycontrol reports from AMFI data. October inflows slowed after September's quarter-end bunching, but the ten-month total still set a record.

items.title: What's Gold price future in India? Will it touch ₹1.50 lakh per 10 grams again by December 2026? Experts' view
items.summary: Experts are split on whether MCX gold can return to Rs 1.50 lakh per 10 g by December. Kotak Neo's Kaynat Chainwala says it needs an 8% rise and a spot break above $4,220 an ounce; Choice Broking's Kaveri More calls it achievable above Rs 1,42,800-1,46,100. SEBI-registered analyst Anuj Gupta is cautious, warning of more selling if the Fed hikes 50 basis points and flagging $3,800 as key support.

items.title: Gold under the pump as dollar sensitivity surges
items.summary: Gold’s sensitivity to the dollar is near historical extremes, FOREX.com’s StoneX analysis finds: the 252-session beta to the dollar index is -2.47, in the 99th percentile since 1976, and gold has been about 5.42 times as volatile as the dollar. Tuesday’s 2.61% slide came as the two-year Treasury yield jumped 18 basis points, the largest single-session rise of 2026.

items.title: Goldman Trims Gold Targets as Central Bank Buying Collides With a Hawkish Fed
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut its year-end 2026 gold forecast to $4,150 an ounce from $4,650, and its end-2027 call to $4,800 from $5,400, citing the Federal Reserve's tighter stance. The bank still sees structural central-bank buying as long-term support: China added gold for a 24th straight month in October, and the World Gold Council put September net central-bank buying at 61 tonnes, the highest of 2026.

items.title: Gold closed below $4,000 again — the ETF crowd and central banks stayed, the momentum money left
items.summary: Gold's slide below $4,000 was driven by leveraged and momentum sellers, not strategic holders, Mitrade argues: managed-money net longs fell to 324 tonnes, their lowest in 21 weeks, while central banks bought 321 tonnes in the third quarter, up 42% on the year, and gold ETF holdings hit a record 4,256 tonnes at the end of September.

items.title: India Gold Demand 2026: Why Are Indians Buying Less Gold?
items.summary: India's gold demand fell 12% to 443.9 tonnes in January-September 2026, with jewellery demand down 18% to 241.1 tonnes, as record prices and the May import-duty hike curbed buying, Business Outreach reports from World Gold Council data. Full-year demand is estimated at about 650 tonnes, the lowest since 2020, while gold ETF inflows rose 47%.

items.title: Customs duty hike takes the shine off organised gold trade; smuggling rises
items.summary: Gold smuggling rose to about 50 tonnes in July-September, more than 16 times the roughly 3 tonnes a year earlier and about 37% of India's 136-tonne total supply, after the import duty rise from 6% to 15%, World Gold Council demand data show. Official bullion imports fell 70% to 64 tonnes, and evading the duty on 1 kg of gold saved about Rs 18.3 lakh, or about Rs 22.5 lakh with GST avoided.

items.title: India Needs Better Gold Mining Evaluation: NITI Aayog CEO
items.summary: NITI Aayog chief executive Anurag Jain called for a proper evaluation matrix for awarding gold exploration and mining projects, PTI reports, to build technical competence and cut India's import dependence. A meeting on the Pahle India Foundation report cited geological data gaps, limited exploration, long project timelines and auction design as hurdles.
